title: Pokémon Center services
description: The fees, rates and lists of the Pokémon Centers' upstairs attendants (docs/paperwhite2/design/pokemon-center.md): the Day Care attendant, Training Services and the Wonder Trade. tools/paperwhite2/pokemon_center.py checks the whole file and writes the parts the game reads into paperwhite2/pokemon_center_config.h; all three attendants' sections are read.

champion_discount_percent.description: Once the player has entered the Hall of Fame (EVENT_FLAG_0x0960), every attendant's fees in money cost this percent less (rounded in the player's favour), wherever they are shown and charged; each attendant says so once a visit. The Day Care's own fee for a withdrawal isn't the Center's, so it stays

champion_discount_battle_points.description: Whether the discount applies to Battle Points too (Hyper Training's, which needs the Hall of Fame anyway)

champion_discount_items.description: Whether the discount applies to items taken as a fee too (the Move Relearner's Heart Scales), at least one

daycare.description: The Day Care attendant (the left counter): remote access to the Route 3 Day Care through the tube behind her

transfer_fee.description: The Center's fee in Pokédollars for each transfer through the tube: a deposit, a withdrawal or an Egg. A withdrawal also costs the Day Care's own fee (100 + 100 a level gained)

required_badges.description: The Gym Badges the player needs before she opens the counter (0 for always); until then she explains where the tube goes

training.description: Training Services: one attendant with a scrolling list of services (res/field/scripts/global_10105.s)

name_rater.description: Renaming a Pokémon; ones with another OT are refused

move_relearner.description: The relearner's screen, for money and an item

hyper_training.description: One stat's IV to 31, for Battle Points

requires_champion.description: Whether the player must have entered the Hall of Fame (EVENT_FLAG_0x0960)

ability.description: Swapping the two normal abilities, or changing to the hidden one

grooming.description: The three grooming courses, each raising friendship to at most 255; the menu names them Brush, Deluxe and Royal (res/text/script/global_10105.txt)

ball_change.description: Moving a Pokémon into a ball from the bag, which is taken too

nature_change.description: Changing the nature, which Gen 5 keeps in a field of its own, so the PID stays

wonder_trade.description: The Wonder Trade (the middle counter, res/field/scripts/global_10100.s): a party or Box Pokémon traded for one this generates (src/paperwhite2/ov012/paperwhite2_wonder_trade.c)

level_spread.description: The received Pokémon's level is the sent one's plus or minus 1 to this (0 for the same level), clamped to 1-100

excluded_species.description: The species that are never received nor can be sent: the legendaries and mythicals. Any other National Pokédex species can be received

other_evolution_levels.description: The least level of a species that evolves by anything but a level (friendship, a stone, a trade, a move, a place): by its evolution stage, and never below its pre-evolution's. A species that evolves at a level needs that level. A received species below its least level is its pre-evolution instead

forms.description: The species received in a form other than their first: each with a weight for each of its forms (as many as res/pokemon's forms.count; 0 for a form never received), or season for Deerling and Sawsbuck, whose form is the season's as the game gives them. A received species not listed is form 0. Left out: forms that change in battle or by an item or event (Castform, Cherrim, Darmanitan's Zen Mode, Rotom's appliances, which come with their own move, the Spiky-eared Pichu) and the excluded species'. A form stays through evolution, as in the game (Burmy's cloak, Shellos' sea)

season.description: The form is the season's (spring, summer, autumn, winter)

languages.description: The original trainers' languages, each with its weight and its trainers' names and nicknames (packed into the system text bank wonder_trade_names). A foreign Pokémon is named in its language. Names are at most 7 characters (5 in Japanese and Korean), nicknames 10 (5)

female_trainer_percent.description: Chance the original trainer is female, with a name from female_names

balls.description: The balls the received Pokémon may be in, each with its weight out of their total

item_tiers.description: The held items' tiers, each with its weight (out of the tiers' total) and items, drawn evenly unless an item has its own weight

special_reward.description: The one-time special reward (the Spiky-eared Pichu), off until its form and sprite exist: a fixed Pokémon, never shiny, with the player as its trainer, received once (EVENT_FLAG_WONDER_TRADE_SPECIAL_RECEIVED) with the attendant's own dialogue

percent.description: Chance a trade until it is received

guaranteed_at.description: The trade that gives it at the latest, counting every trade (EVENT_WORK_WONDER_TRADE_COUNT)

ability_slot.description: The first normal ability, the second, or 2 for the hidden one
